_comment: The recorded readings (onprem, qwen3.5-9b-dw, prompt sales.reply_intent@2.0.0, 2026-11-15) read 0.8 of the 60 golden thread messages as exactly their intents (0.816 of the 49 outside the conditional and non-answer ones, the bar's set; the bar is 0.85, so the step stays gated until a measurement passes) and read none of the 11 conditional acceptances and polite non-answers as accepts.
